title: A small file store
hints: readJsonOr: catch the error of readFile only, and return the fallback when error.code === "ENOENT". Parse outside the try, so a JSON error is thrown on.
saveJson: await mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); then writeFile to file + ".tmp", then rename.
findFiles: a recursive helper that receives the folder and the relative prefix, and uses readdir(folder, { withFileTypes: true }).
